data.title: 不知火舞 · 发簪的传承
data.description: 她的房间，她对着镜子把祖母的发簪别进发间，动作郑重；簪子的光泽映着她少见的、安静的表情——流派与家族都别在这一枚簪子上。
data.action: 她的房间，她对着镜子把祖母的发簪别进发间，动作郑重
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui carefully secures her grandmother's treasured hairpin beside the base of her high ponytail, checking its position in the bedroom mirror. Her cream sleeves and tailored dark trousers remain simple as her expression grows unusually quiet. The medium portrait includes the open wooden case on the dressing surface. Morning light catches the ornament's worn shine and her reflected brown eyes, with a darker case lining and soft sleeve shadows below her hands.
